facts.business: Inani Marbles & Industries Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and trading of marble, granite slabs, quartz grains, and related stone products.
key_risks: Pressure on operating margins due to challenging global business environment
Geopolitical uncertainties across various parts of the world
Disruptions in international trade and supply chains
Volatility in commodity and input costs
Changes and uncertainty relating to tariff policies in the United States impacting international trade and export markets
facts.related_party_note: Material related party transactions approved for FY 2026-27: (1) Atlas Marble and Granite Tr. up to Rs. 10.00 Crore for sales or supply of goods/material. (2) Miraak Surfaces Private Limited (details truncated in excerpt).
